# Shared SoLoud audio native crash SIGABRT in SoLoud::DiskFile::pos() across three games

- Apps: com.ruicodex.ant_empire, com.ruicodex.grandmaskitchen, com.ruicodex.mergekingdom
- Affected versions: 4, 6, 10
- Suspected component: SoLoud::DiskFile
- Source issue: K-49493c67 (severity 4)

## Symptoms
Identical native SIGABRT with cause [split_config.arm64_v8a.apk] SoLoud::DiskFile::pos() in com.ruicodex.ant_empire, com.ruicodex.grandmaskitchen, and com.ruicodex.mergekingdom

## User impact
App crashes via native SIGABRT during audio file handling, terminating the app session

## First step
Pin and update SoLoud native library to a single fixed version across all three apps and reproduce audio init to verify SoLoud::DiskFile::pos() SIGABRT is resolved, adding fallback to silent mode if init fails.

## Evidence
- C-99679ff32c
- C-31d8142174
- C-dd4a32d11c
- C-3fc75892fe
- C-d901bfd4c7

# Florea startup crash on 2.0: black screen hang with Gson TypeToken RuntimeException

- Apps: com.ruicodex.florea
- Affected versions: 2.0
- Suspected component: com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken (Gson deserialization)
- Source issue: K-03faf827 (severity 4)

## Symptoms
After update to 2.0 app does not start, shows black screen then hangs; Play vitals show java.lang.RuntimeException at com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken.getSuperclassTypeParameter

## User impact
App unusable after update, cannot launch for offline writing, reported as 1-star startup failure

## First step
Reproduce cold start on 2.0 build using a pre-update journal file and capture the generic type passed to Gson TypeToken that throws RuntimeException in getSuperclassTypeParameter

## Evidence
- S-40df909529
- C-84cfc86e50
- C-0ae4c10df3
- C-d339d5b605

# IdleFactory Era-3 freeze, offline earnings zero and lag

- Apps: com.ruicodex.IdleFactoryTycoon
- Affected versions: 1.4.0, 1.4.1, 1.4.2-era3-patch, 1.4.3
- Suspected component: Era-3 production multiplier and offline-earnings clock handling
- Source issue: K-a526d510 (severity 4)

## Symptoms
Since Era-3 update: game freezes requiring force-close, offline earnings show zero, Era-3 factories not doubling production, progress rolls back on restart, with severe lag, overheating and battery drain

## User impact
Players in Era-3 cannot progress reliably due to freezes requiring force-close, lost offline earnings, missing production doubling and rollback, plus lag and overheating

## First step
Reproduce Era-3 freeze and profile main thread during Era-3 gameplay to locate blocking work causing Input dispatching timeout ANRs

- S-79d999df9a
- S-ac9f0cdc14
- S-c68abd8606
